findings.description: The GREEN criterion for `parquet_queue_overflow_count` omits the evaluation window, unlike the other three required counters which each explicitly state 'within the last `evidenceguard_window_s`'. An implementation could interpret 'not increasing' as 'not incrementing at this exact instant' (effectively fail-open on burst overflow) or 'never incremented in system lifetime' (overly strict). The omission creates an exploitable ambiguity in the GREEN predicate.

evidence.context: Contrast with lines 35–36 and 38 which each say 'has not increased within the last `evidenceguard_window_s`'

findings.proposed_fix: Replace with: '`parquet_queue_overflow_count` has not increased within the last `evidenceguard_window_s`' to match the window-bounded formulation of the other three required counters.

findings.description: AT-414 asserts that an attribution row write failure must force EvidenceChainState to not-GREEN, but the required counter list (line 32) does not include an `attribution_write_errors` counter. No existing required counter (`truth_capsule_write_errors`, `decision_snapshot_write_errors`, `wal_write_errors`, `parquet_queue_overflow_count`) maps to attribution failures. The fail-closed mechanism is undefined: implementations have no specified counter to increment, making AT-414 unenforceable against the counter-based GREEN predicate.
findings.proposed_fix: Add `attribution_write_errors` to the required counters list and specify that it MUST increment on any failure to write an attribution row for a filled OPEN intent; update the GREEN criterion to require it has not increased within `evidenceguard_window_s`.

findings.description: `evidenceguard_global_cooldown` appears in the clear hysteresis formula (line 44: 'cleared only after max(queue_clear_window_s, evidenceguard_global_cooldown)') and is overridden to 0 in AT-422, implying a non-zero default exists. However, the fixture never states the default value, and line 26 also relies on this cooldown ('until GREEN recovers and remains stable for the cooldown window'). Without a specified default, the exit criterion from ReduceOnly is underspecified and implementations will diverge.

evidence.quote: cleared only after max(queue_clear_window_s, evidenceguard_global_cooldown) with all criteria satisfied
evidence.context: AT-422 line 95 overrides evidenceguard_global_cooldown=0, implying a non-zero default that is never defined in this fixture.

findings.proposed_fix: Add a normative default for `evidenceguard_global_cooldown` (e.g., 60s) to Appendix A and reference it in the clear hysteresis rule alongside the existing `evidenceguard_counters_max_age_ms` entry.
